name: Gallant Leadership
body:
You have synergized aspects of your knightly training with your leadership skills to fulfill your noblesse oblige.

Prerequisites: 3rd level in both cavalier (or legendary cavalier) and marshal classes, challenge (or commander’s aura for legendary cavalier), inspire action, vital inspiration, and 4 skill ranks in Diplomacy, Knowledge (local), Knowledge (nobility), and Sense Motive.

Benefit: If you have cavalier levels, your cavalier and marshal class levels stack together for the purpose of determining your total daily uses of challenge. If you have legendary cavalier levels instead, your legendary cavalier and marshal class levels stack together for the purposes of determining your total daily rounds of commander’s aura. Your cavalier (or legendary cavalier) and marshal class levels stack together for the purpose of determining your effective marshal class levels when calculating how many additional hit points (equal to half your marshal class levels) you heal with vital inspiration to a target of your inspire action. This does not affect calculating your effective class levels for any other aspects of these class abilities.

You also stack your cavalier (or legendary cavalier) and marshal class levels together to determine your effective cavalier (or legendary cavalier) and marshal levels for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of social talents (for legendary cavalier) and feats.
